3661-5006-5231-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Shield Sphere is starting in your graveyard.
3661-5006-5231-8170.description:
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Shield Sphere spell. Then, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Shield Sphere, adding {R}
Repeat.

1722-2034-3583-5931.easyPrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-3583-5931.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
When the Tentacle dies, Funeral Room triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Oloro triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2

2169-4694-7306-8249.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2169-4694-7306-8249.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {U}{G}, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Resolve Defiant Salvager's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

4279-6794-6887--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-6794-6887--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn, The Skullspore Nexus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus ability, creating a X/X Fungus creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2137-4642-5223.description:
Cast Awaken the Woods with X equal to 3 by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands you control to their owner's hand, copying Awaken the Woods.
Resolve the copy of Awaken the Woods, creating three 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature tokens.
Activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.
2137-4642-5223.notes: Once you have infinite green mana and infinite land tokens, you may activate Uyo any number of times, targeting any number of instant or sorcery spells.

969-5078-6766-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

225-813-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
225-813-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Scholar of the Ages and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Scholar of the Ages and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve a Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining trigger.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
Repeat steps 6 through 9 once.
Repeat from step 1.
225-813-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Scholar of the Ages and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

1424-4687-5296.notablePrerequisites: Workhorse has at least four counters on it.
1424-4687-5296.description:
Activate Presence of Gond by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Workhorse.
Activate Workhorse as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Workhorse, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

2842-4681-5170-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

851-2557-5478-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
851-2557-5478-6753-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

261-4017-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
261-4017-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The other Hero triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

240-4875-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Conspiracy, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-4875-5147.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

779-1940-2178-4050-7409.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four land cards in your graveyard.
779-1940-2178-4050-7409.description:
Activate Lluwen by paying {2}{B/G}{B/G}{B/G}, tapping it and discarding Dakmor Salvage, creating a 1/1 Wurm creature token for each land card in your graveyard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five Wurms, adding {2}{B/G}{B/G}{B/G}.
When the Wurms die, Liliana, Dreadhorde General and Lluwen trigger five times each.
Resolve all Lluwen triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the first Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger, instead choosing to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve all remaining Liliana, Dreadhorde General triggers, drawing that many cards.
Repeat.
779-1940-2178-4050-7409.notes: As you mill cards, inevitably more lands will end up in your graveyard, meaning you'll make more tokens over time.

1849-2440-7082-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka's first ability and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, attaching Trusty Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

413-3968-7124.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
413-3968-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Grave Titan as attackers.
Grave Titan triggers, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter, Blasting Station triggers that many times, untapping Blasting Station.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2906-4907-6798-6989.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 3 life this turn.
2906-4907-6798-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rakdos. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

2034-2173-4740-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional nontoken creature.
2034-2173-4740-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying X life, where X is the creature's mana value.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Repeat.
2034-2173-4740-5220.notes: Your starting life total will need to be at least a certain number depending on the mana value of the creature you are sacrificing to perform this combo. This list shows the minimum life total you would need to have, from mana value 1 (left) to 10 (right): 2, 4, 7, 11, 16, 22, 29, 37, 46, 56. You can also cast spells to reduce the needed life to start.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1878-2455-2713-3454-6811.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has six or more cards in hand.
1878-2455-2713-3454-6811.description:
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Jeska's Will and casting it without paying its mana cost, adding at least six {R}.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Zirda.
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Big Score and casting it without paying its mana cost and discarding a card.
Resolve Big Score, causing you to draw two cards and create two Treasures.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Zirda.
Activate Reito Sentinel twice by paying {2}, putting Big Score and Jeska's Will from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{W}.
Repeat.

2054-2440-4183-4404.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Corridor Monitor
2054-2440-4183-4404.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Corridor Monitor with haste.
When the token Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Corridor Monitor trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Corridor Monitor, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Corridor Monitor for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Urn of Godfire twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

372-1567-2239.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Momentary Blink exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Ardent Elementalist exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Momentary Blink.
372-1567-2239.description:
Cast Momentary Blink by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Ardent Elementalist and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Ardent Elementalist trigger.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Momentary Blink from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Momentary Blink.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Ardent Elementalist and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

372-1809-1922.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Blur exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1809-1922.description:
Cast Blur by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Returned Pastcaller and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Returned Pastcaller trigger.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller trigger, returning Blur from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Blur.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Returned Pastcaller and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1479-3585-5233.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3585-5233.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it, Greensleeves, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Greensleeves trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1909-2691-4486.notablePrerequisites: Ilysian Caryatid does not have summoning sickness. You control a creature with power 4 or greater who has at least a +3/+0 boost from secondary effects.
1909-2691-4486.description:
Activate Ilysian Caryatid by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Ilysian Caryatid.
Repeat.

1429-2829-5958.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-2829-5958.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Curator Beastie.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2034-2762-3000.description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Squirrel, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Thopter Squadron's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Thopter, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3490-5231-5402.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
3490-5231-5402.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a Pirate you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Captain Storm trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a Pirate you control.
Repeat from step 3.

945-997-1385-2452-2530.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
945-997-1385-2452-2530.description:
Cast Relentless Dead by paying {0}.
When Relentless Dead enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Relentless Dead.
When Relentless Dead dies, its first and second abilities trigger, as well as Zulaport Cutthroat.
Resolve the first Relentless Dead trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return Relentless Dead from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second Relentless Dead trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

4316-5060-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

1644-3505-4423-4693-4826.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two Plains.
Archelos is untapped.
1644-3505-4423-4693-4826.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and two Plains by tapping them, adding at least {1}{W}{W}.
Activate Overgrown Estate three times by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary and two Plains, causing you to gain 9 life.
Cast Second Sunrise by paying {1}{W}{W}, returning all land cards put into your graveyard this turn to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When each land enters the battlefield, Tatyova triggers that many times, and Mystic Sanctuary triggers once.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Second Sunrise on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Tatyova triggers, causing you to draw that many cards and gain that much life.
Repeat.
If you control additional lands, you may sacrifice them as well to get additional mana and triggers.

511-3008-3048-5115.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Gemstone Array has at least one charge counter on it.
Sporoloth Ancient has at least one spore counter on it.
511-3008-3048-5115.description:
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing the creature it is attached to to become a copy of Roalesk.
Put the creature with Blade of Shared Souls attached into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The creature triggers, putting two spore counters on Sporoloth Ancient and two charge counters on Gemstone Array.
Activate Sporoloth Ancient by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability twice by removing two charge counters from it, adding {2}.
Repeat.

222-1849-4050-5168.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Bloom Tender and Slimefoot and Squee, adding two mana of any color(s).
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning Slimefoot and Squee and Bloom Tender to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

632-2034-2178-5004.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Scarecrone.
Scarecrone does not have summoning sickness.
632-2034-2178-5004.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cathodion, adding {C}{C}.
Cathodion dies, triggering itself and Scarecrone.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Scarecrone trigger, untapping it.
Activate Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Cathodion from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
